test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab_16 (id UInt32, vec QBit(BFloat16, {vector_size})) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE tab_32 (id UInt32, vec QBit(Float32, {vector_size})) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE tab_64 (id UInt32, vec QBit(Float64, {vector_size})) ENGINE = Memory
INSERT INTO tab_{bits} SELECT number + 1 AS id, arrayMap(i -> id + i - 1, range({vector_size})) AS vec FROM numbers({elements})
